name: PR439 header reachability evidence

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - evidence/pr439-header-reachability

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  header-reachability:
    name: Frozen six-seed header reachability
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Provenance
        shell: bash
        run: |
          echo "HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
          git log --oneline -6
      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '8.0.x'
      - name: Run exact #441 diagnostic
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 tools/dotnet-ci/generate_projects.py
          dotnet restore tools/dotnet-ci/TacticalDirector.gen.sln
          dotnet test src/match-engine/tests/match-engine-tests.gen.csproj \
            --no-restore \
            --filter "Name=HeaderReachability_LocalizesFirstZeroOnFrozenCorpus" \
            --logger "console;verbosity=detailed"
